defined as the risk
of loss resulting from
inadequate or failed
internal processes,
people, systems, or
external events.

Application of enhanced business standards

Our Operational Risk & Control Management
Framework which includes the tools, processes
and standardised reporting necessary to identify,
measure, manage, monitor and report on the
operational risks and the controls in place to
mitigate those risks within centrally set tolerances.

column2:
Operational risk should generally be reduced
to as low a level as is commercially sensible.

appropriate level of capital to be held in respect of
operational risks.

Ongoing investment in simplifying our technology
to improve the resilience and reliability of our
systems and in IT security to protect ours and our
customers’ data.
